senses.gloss: (= לִחְלוּחַ) making palatable by moistening, as dipping into vinegar &c.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 8:2:11">Y. Ber. VIII, 12ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>כל דבר שיש בו ל׳ משקה</he> any food which is likely to be moistened with a liquid.

<cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 5:6">Ruth R. to II, 14</cite> (ref. to <he>וטבלת וכ׳</he> <cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 5:6">ib.</cite>) <he>זה ל׳ מעשים</he> this is symbolical of the seasoning of (Solomon’s) deeds, i.e. of his amending his deeds, v. <cite ref="L00553"><he>לִכְלֵךְ</he></cite>.—[Pesik. Eth. Korb., p. 58ᵃ, a. e., v. <cite ref="L00360"><he>לִחְלוּךְ</he></cite>.]

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 23">Midr. Till. to Ps. XXIII</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 808:1">Yalk. Deut. 808</cite> (play on <he>לכתך</he> <cite ref="Deuteronomy 2:7">Deut. II, 7</cite>) <he>הילוכך לִכְלוּכְךָ וכ׳</he> thy travels, thy getting soiled and thy pains about thy support.—Pl. <he>לִכְלוּכִין</he>, <cite ref="L00551"><he>לִיכְ׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 9:4">Mikv. IX, 4</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Mikvaot 6:17">Tosef. ib. VI, 17</cite> <he>לִכְלוּכֵי צואה</he> the (moist) stains of excrements.
<cite ref="Tosefta Mikvaot 6:9">Ib. 9</cite> <he>ל׳ פירות</he> ed. Zuck. (ed. <he>לכולם</he>, corr. acc.) stains of fruit-juice.
<cite ref="Tosefta Mikvaot 6:18">Ib. 18</cite> <he>ל׳ שמרים שבכיס</he> the muddy sediments in the cup.
